# FDGA032

> DO specify the `readonly` modifier for fields or methods immediately after the member slot modifier (if specified).

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.5 Member Modifiers.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0036
- Automatic fix: yes
